verdict.rationale: Canva's first-party MCP docs state it can create designs from text descriptions and apply targeted edits to existing designs through natural-language commands. They also describe natural-language access to Canva's design capabilities, and the main docs reference designing with Canva AI. The evidence covers the core story, but every claim is a single bullet-level vendor statement, and generation is documented mainly through AI assistants connected via MCP. Missing for 10: detailed docs on what drafts, layouts or mockups are actually produced, any hands-on or independent corroboration of output quality, and documentation of in-editor prompt-to-design generation beyond a passing Canva AI mention.
